Diagram.navigationHelp: Drag to pan, wheel or pinch to zoom. With the keyboard: arrows to pan, + / − to zoom, Home to fit.
Diagram.editHelp: Drag a person to move them. Only the shaded cells accept a person; releasing snaps to the nearest free cell. Dragging the background still pans the chart. Focus ⤧ to move by one cell with the arrow keys (five with Shift). ⟲ returns that person to the automatic layout. Resize the boxes by dragging the right edge, bottom edge or corner of the top-left box (it applies to the whole chart; arrow keys work too). Hold Shift or Ctrl (Cmd on Mac) while clicking, or use ☐, to add people to the selection — all selected people then move together. The ＋ icons along the top and left insert an empty column or row at that gap; a − appears on columns and rows with nobody in them and removes that line.
Diagram.gridLines: Insert or remove rows and columns
Diagram.gridLinesBlocked: Rows and columns cannot be changed right now: two people share a cell, or the layout overrides have reached their limit. Use “Reset to automatic layout” to discard the overrides.
Diagram.insertColumnAt: Insert an empty column before column {n}
Diagram.insertRowAt: Insert an empty row before row {n}
Diagram.resizeWidth: Change the box width (drag the right edge of the top-left box)
Diagram.resizeHeight: Change the box height (drag the bottom edge of the top-left box)
Diagram.resizeBoth: Change the box size (drag the corner of the top-left box)
Diagram.discardNote: Unsaved layout changes will be lost.
Diagram.resetTitle: Reset everything to the automatic layout?
Diagram.resetNote: Every manual placement and box size returns to the default. Nothing is committed until you save.
Diagram.emptyState: Open a diagram file (.diagram.json) to see the chart here.
